### 2026-10-31: oct 31 - Footprints and PCB design

**6h**

oct 31 - Footprints and PCB design

Today I did all the footprints and the PCB routing and design.
Let me tell you something: there is NOTHING worse than checking and rechecking that the product you have matches your footprint, and that matches your schematic, and it's just a very crash-out-able experience. I'm sure for more experienced people it's pretty easy, but it was a nightmare for me.

First, I got what I thought the basic footprints I needed were. So resistors, the microcontroller, all that. My first issue was coordinating the resistor footprint with the resistor I was going to use.

![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/5be952a7306992d709a0148efd3c71eb5ab3a22edf9740737a115f03d73e5433.png)

After that, I needed to import the right key footprint.

![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/9399464848c181d348d2d30877d1a7012af91abd7968608383b2fde9e99592be.png)

then i ran into a big set of issues because I could not find the footprint for the display anywhere.
Digi-Key didn't have the download, so i had to hunt and ultimately ask on Slack and i found it
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/bfaa77611930b542b5b36b44cca711e8eb04276875ed06769cf0133868931134.png)

Then I had to find the Seeed Studio footprint, which i pulled an absolute IDIOT move and imported it like 5 times in all different ways but it wasn't showing up because I was looking for a footprint with the Seeed keyword in it, which the footprint didn't have.
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/04b24d8de66181e0f27c0e83d3054cd84ceaef1722bd5265eeabc55fb8481a60.png)

Me looking for it desperately and trying to trace its path
![Screenshot 2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/10d88af123df56bcdb2bbb27c72578d4b77cbc3ebfe5c4ad05ba49657cb07750.png)
Once I got that in i got started on the PCB design and routing.

My first design was pretty bad because I forgot the outline, and it was a lot of wiring.
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/2b2d5b8f01a417c108c1e5c52cc782444b3f93a2514f2f0d45d9546167ad4d44.png)

but my final design was pretty good!

Tl;DR: finished footprints and pcb design (ran into many issues)
